title: 7 money lessons I wish I knew at *22*

label: LESSON 1
head: Money is a skill. Study it like one.
sub: Nobody becomes a dentist without reading a single book about teeth.

label: LESSON 2
head: Looking rich is not being rich
sub: Skip the $90 dinner. Real friends get it.

items.head: Know what you want
items.sub: And stop explaining it to people who don't get it.

items.head: Learn loans before you need one
items.sub: Car, mortgage, insurance. Emotion makes bad deals.

label: LESSON 5
head: Rich people aren't the enemy
sub: Resent them and you'll quietly sabotage your own money.

label: LESSON 6
head: Save the $50 anyway
sub: Blow $50 now and you'll blow $5,000 later.

label: LESSON 7
head: Start investing before you feel ready
sub: Start at 20, not 30, and you need about half the money to hit $1M by 50.

text: There will always be a reason to wait. *Start this month.*
